122675: The owner of Western Restaurant Nekoya, a historic restaurant in the basement of a multi-tenant building in one corner of a shopping district. He inherited the restaurant from his father ten years ago.
122699: A young demon girl who found Western Restaurant Nekoya while jobless and down on her luck, and ended up being hired there. Through the people she’s met at Nekoya, she’s found some job leads back in her own world, as well.
122700: The avatar of a black dragon who, like Aletta, works at Western Restaurant Nekoya. When she comes to the restaurant, she takes the form of an elf girl and uses her power of telepathy to speak to others. She has a bit of an obsession with chicken curry.
122701: A majestic scarlet red dragon goddess and a regular at Nekoya. She is always seen visiting Nekoya during closing hour when it is empty to order her favorite food, beef stew. She considers Nekoya and all the staff there to be a part of her clan and will protect them from all harm.
122702: A young treasure hunter. After meeting Aletta at Nekoya, she took in the young demon as a live-in maid. Her favorite is minced meat cutlets.
122703: A knight captain who saved the duchy from disaster and was given a fortress as a reward. Because he was born in a port town, he prefers seafood. His favorite is fried shrimp.
122704: One of the four heroes who ended the war with the demons, known as the legendary Great Sage. He is the most senior of Nekoya's regulars. His favorite is pork loin cutlets.
122705: A legendary swordsman whose exploits have been sung about all over the world by minstrels. Friends with Artorius. His favorite is teriyaki chicken.
123174: The elder sister of the duke, and a brilliant sorcerer. Both her parents were human, but she was born a half-elf and chose the path of a sorcerer. Her favorite is pudding a la mode.
123175: An elven culinary researcher. She won't eat any foods that contain animal products. Inspired by Nekoya's cuisine, she travels around the world learning all she can about cooking. Her favorite is tofu steak.
123176: The heir to the Alfade Company. His grandfather Thomas, the former head of the company, introduced him to Nekoya. His favorite is meat sauce, but he struggles to replicate it.
123177: The first princess of the empire. While on sick leave at the palace villa, she began visiting Nekoya regularly and began to gradually recover. Her favorite is chocolate parfaits.
123338: A young fisherman. He was caught in a storm at sea and was on the brink of drowning before the mermaid, Arte, saved his life.
123339: The prince who made iced coffee popular in the Land of Sand. He has fallen for the "Lovely Lady" Adelheid. His favorite is coffee floats.
123340: Princess of the Land of Sand. She speaks in a masculine manner around her half-brother Shareef. Her favorite is soda floats.
123341: A human and the little sister of Sarah Gold. Unlike her sister, she is more lady like and has no interest in adventures and treasure hunting.
123342: A wood elf from the Elvin Capital and a regular at Nekoya. Being a friend of Fardania's parents, he too discovered Nekoya and his new favorite foods, miso and tofu. Ever since his first visit to Nekoya, he has been trying to find a way to replicate miso and tofu with elven beans.
123343: A mermaid living in the other world and a regular at Nekoya. She first discovered Nekoya many years ago and began visiting every week after experiencing their hamburger steak.
